accessKey.title: Access key
accessKey.lead: The hub {{hub}} is protected by an access key. Enter it to continue: it stays saved on this device, for this hub only.
accessKey.label: Key
accessKey.hint: It is the REKORD_ACCESS_KEY value set on the hub. Ask whoever runs the hub.
accessKey.errFormat: The key has at least {{min}} characters: letters, digits and . _ ~ -
accessKey.errInvalid: Wrong key. Check it and try again.
accessKey.errStoredInvalid: The saved key no longer works: it may have been changed on the hub. Enter the new one.
accessKey.errLocked: Wrong key. After too many wrong attempts, every wrong key is refused for about a minute: the right key still works.
accessKey.errLockedFor: Wrong key. After too many wrong attempts, every wrong key is refused for {{seconds}} s: the right key still works.
accessKey.errUnreachable: Hub unreachable. Check the connection and try again.
accessKey.errNotHub: Unexpected answer: there is no RE-KORD hub at this address.
core.api.errorCode.access_key_required: This hub requires an access key.
core.api.errorCode.access_key_rate_limit: Wrong key, and too many wrong attempts for now. The right key still works.
accessKey.errQrInvalid: The hub refused the key in the QR code. Type it by hand or create a new QR in the hub panel.
accessKey.settingsHint: The key stays on this device only and is sent to this hub only.
accessKey.status.ok: This hub requires a key: the one saved here is valid.
accessKey.status.off: This hub does not require an access key.
accessKey.status.missing: This hub requires a key and none is saved on this device.
accessKey.status.invalid: The saved key no longer works: enter the new one.
accessKey.status.locked: The saved key is wrong and there were too many wrong attempts: enter the right one, it still works.
accessKey.status.unknown: The key could not be checked: the hub is not answering.
accessKey.forgetBody: It will be deleted from this device. If the hub requires it, you will have to enter it again to continue.
connect.embeddedHubKeyError: The built-in hub did not start: REKORD_ACCESS_KEY is set but not valid (empty, shorter than 32 characters, or with characters other than A–Z a–z 0–9 . _ ~ -). Fix or remove it and restart the app.
